Quantum Atom Simulator: 3D Atoms, Molecules and Nuclei

Quantum Atom is a free, browser-based 3D simulator that draws electron orbitals as real probability clouds instead of dots on rails. Pick any of the 118 elements, explore molecules, promote electrons to excited states, switch to antimatter, or dive into the nucleus. No install and no account.

What you can explore

  • All 118 elements from hydrogen to oganesson, with their s, p and d orbitals in 3D.
  • Molecules such as water, ammonia and benzene with VSEPR geometry, plus a build mode for other compounds.
  • Guided lessons on covalent bonds, VSEPR shapes and how the periodic table fills up.
  • Side-by-side element comparison and a Bohr model versus quantum model view.
  • Excited states, antimatter mode, light and dark themes and a colorblind-safe palette.

Quick Examples
Type a name in any language, a formula (H2SO4), an ion (SO4 2-), a SMILES string or a PubChem CID. Simple formulas are built on your device; everything else is looked up online.
